args: P="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; cd "$P" || exit 1; ok() { "$1" -e 'process.exit(Number(process.versions.node.split(".")[0])>=22?0:1)' 2>/dev/null; }; N=; for c in node /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node /usr/local/opt/node@22/bin/node; do if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ok "$c"; then N="$c"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$N" ]; then echo 'metravel-knowledge: нужен Node >= 22 (node в PATH или brew node@22)' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$N" --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/ai-index/mcp.ts
